name: forecast.accuracy
summary: Native forecast accuracy metrics and record-bound cashflow occurrences.
purpose: Inspect one account and creation-query day with the approved accuracy summary and native cashflow-to-statement comparisons.

list.description: Read bounded base records, all native accuracy metrics, and record-bound cashflow occurrences.

parameters.name: record-date
parameters.description: Native creation-query day YYYY-MM-DD; distinct from returned valueDate/baseValueDate.

identity_description: Native nonempty base record id; every id retains its independently request-bound metrics.

fields.name: accuracy
fields.meaning: Approved native metric fields, unscaled, bound by this record in the metric request.

fields.name: cashflow_details
fields.meaning: Entire native occurrence array in source order, preserving repeats, Money objects and unknown fields.

limitations: One explicit account and one native creation-query day. Full creation-time range 000000 through 235959; source timezone remains unknown.

GET /bankCashForecastRecordAccuracyQuery.json once through the standard named List collector with fixed width 5000 and native result.count/id coverage; require complete base acquisition and at most 100 base rows before dependent calls. The 100 limit is a client budget, not a backend capacity statement.

GET /cashFlowDetailDay.json once per base row, bound to native id/valueDate/accountNo/instId/currency/bankId/forecastBalance and selected alias. Existing 12 base and 11 scalar accuracy fields remain unchanged; absent projected values remain null.

GET /cashFlowDetail.json once per raw parent with native valueDate/accountNo/instId/tntInstId/currency/bankId/id and selected alias. gmtCreate retains a native integer or explicit null when present, and is omitted when absent, matching the frontend JSON serialization.

Cashflow occurrence arrays preserve order, identical repeated rows, unknown fields, Money components and amount strings. No invented identity, matching, rescaling, paging, total or 5000-row UI truncation is applied.

The complete native occurrence array is the qualified single-response boundary for the exact parent request. Native result.count and per-row zero paging fields are observations, not totals; effective occurrence reported_total remains unknown. No paging fields are sent and no backend capacity or atomic snapshot is inferred.

Each native child retains its exact request association in acquisition evidence; absent native identity echoes remain absent, and contradictory provided context fails. Child success and occurrence arrivals do not replace base coverage or prove source atomicity.
Native zero-balance strings 0.0/0.00 use request value 0 for metrics only, matching the existing binding; output forecastBalance is unchanged.

All required inquiries share the existing 303-physical-request and 300-second operation budgets, including retries. Business/auth/transport/schema/binding failures abort without a successful prefix or publication.

Live never publishes. Incomplete, failed and successful-empty refreshes preserve the previous compatible capture under host policy. Changed adapter contracts reject old summary-only captures; no cache migration or child fallback is provided. No public Get, new leaf, task execution or Duckdog import is introduced.
